title: Are GPUs Emotionally Stable? A Large-Scale Empirical Study Under 24/7 Training Stress
summary: We conduct the first psychological evaluation of modern GPUs under extreme training conditions. Results reveal that 87% of devices exhibit symptoms of burnout after repeated “just one more epoch” requests.

title: Instant Noodles as a Scalable Training Infrastructure for Graduate Students
summary: We introduce Noodle-Scaling Law, showing that research productivity increases logarithmically with instant noodle consumption before collapsing catastrophically at 3 a.m.
